title: Apply foundational security operations concepts: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: Which operational responsibility must be separated, approved, measured, and evidenced?
focalInsight: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Two Person Control
nodes.definition: Two-person control: independent concurrence with attribution
nodes.detail: Two-person control: independent concurrence with attribution

nodes.label: Job Rotation
nodes.definition: Rotation: alternate staff exposes hidden dependence/fraud
nodes.detail: Rotation: alternate staff exposes hidden dependence/fraud

altSummary: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.

least privilege: Least privilege: minimum actions. Decision: decide role/scope/time.. Failure/example: broad admin command.

separation of duties: SoD: incompatible duties separated. Decision: decide conflict matrix.. Failure/example: requester approves own payment.
two person control: Two-person control: independent concurrence with attribution. Decision: decide dual approval mechanism.. Failure/example: shared credential.
job rotation: Rotation: alternate staff exposes hidden dependence/fraud. Decision: decide coverage/hand-off.. Failure/example: sole operator concealment.
privileged account management: PAM: separate/strong/audited privilege. Decision: decide approval/session review.. Failure/example: daily-use domain admin.
sla: SLA: measurable provider/team commitment. Decision: decide metric/remedy/escalation.. Failure/example: vague uptime promise.
operational training: Training: operator skill/escalation readiness. Decision: decide role practice/evidence.. Failure/example: emergency procedure unknown.
